notes: Every case is a new chart, the maps registered afresh; animation false; a tooltip hides at once and sits at [5, 5].
A click is mousemove, mousedown, mouseup, click at one point; leave is Handler.mouseout.
Points named by a region are its centre through dataToPoint, rounded.
After every step: chart._onframe() (applyChangedStates) and a display-list refresh.

cases.note: the defaults: hover a region (emphasis: the highlight fill, the lifted border, z2 10, the label shown in the primary colour), then its own label (the same region: out, over), another region, the hole of D (nothing), the line E (its stroke, 5 px wide when unfilled), a multipolygon, a name drawn twice, and leave
emphasis.focus 'self': hovering a region blurs the whole component (paths and labels, a tenth of their opacity) and the region comes back as emphasis; leaving lifts the blur
selectedMode 'single': a click toggles the region and takes the selection off the others; geoselectchanged fires before the click event; a click on the label counts
selectedMode 'multiple' with regions[].selected: C starts selected; clicks add and take away

no selectedMode: a region selected by regions[].selected is shown selected, a click on it unselects it (unSelect does not look at the mode) and a click elsewhere selects nothing -- each still fires geoselectchanged
a written selectedMap wins over regions[].selected

option.selectedMap is the model's: a merge that leaves it alone keeps the selection, one that writes it merges it in (zrUtil.merge), a notMerge setOption starts again from regions[].selected; a render makes new elements (no hover)
two geos: the select actions by query (none: every geo; geoIndex), their events (selected is shared across the geos the action reached, allSelected per geo), a name left out

highlight / downplay on a geo (geoIndex and name): focus 'self' blurs the component; a region held by the action keeps its emphasis through a hover's out; a hover elsewhere blurs it again (blurComponent spares nothing); a name that is no region, no name

state styles from the geo and the regions: areaColor in emphasis, a border width, label colour / size / formatter / rotation in emphasis (the select and blur texts take the emphasis formatter too), select colour, select label hidden, blur opacity and label colour; B emphasis.disabled (no hover emphasis, still its events), C silent, D emphasis colour and areaColor null (the lift)

the region tooltip: the geo's formatter template ({a} the name), a region's string, a region's show: false, a region's function formatter (params: componentType, geoIndex, name, no seriesIndex), a global trigger 'axis' does not stop it

nothing declares an emphasis fill (the geo's written null, no root): the proxy lifts the rest fill; a region whose fill is 'none' gets its stroke lifted instead; a written 'inherit' keeps the rest fill
no tooltip component: no tooltip over a region
clip with a zoom: what the view rect cuts away is not hit; silent on the whole geo in a second one

the root option's emphasis / itemStyle / label are the region model's grandparent: a geo emphasis colour written null climbs to the root's, the root's border colour for emphasis, the root's item opacity
a region's echartsStyle reaches its states: emphasis areaColor, select label colour

guards.detail: the hole of D is not D
the line hits within 2.5 px (max(0.5, 5) / 2) and not at 3
emphasis: the highlight token, the lifted border, z2 10
the emphasis label shows, primary, z2 2 + 10
the first move: move then over
the second move lands on the label: out and over within the region
the tooltip is the region name
out of the regions: no blur
select then emphasis: both lifts from z2 0, the later wins
a list that keeps emphasis lifts again from the current z2
with no selectedMode a click unselects
with no selectedMode a click selects nothing
a render: new elements, no hover
hovering the held region under 'self': blurComponent blurs it and the hover may not lift it
its out: allLeaveBlur puts it to normal, still held
a silent region is not hit
emphasis.disabled: no state, the events still
D: a region's null climbs to the geo's areaColor
a function formatter is called with the state
show false: the box up stays as it was
a silent geo is not hit
